fact: Algeria's Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research launched on 29 April 2025 the Private Digital Adviser, an LLM-based conversational system answering queries on all the ministry's regulatory documents.

The National People's Assembly's secretary general says the Assembly has adopted AI-based cybersecurity solutions and AI tools for automatic transcription and translation of debates, which gave a considerable efficiency gain.
